subject.title: feat: AI safety event taxonomy — UI dashboard and CLI command

question: Should OpenClaw adopt this AI-safety taxonomy and dashboard as a permanent core diagnostics product, including its storage, plugin API, privacy, retention, and protocol contracts?
rationale: The PR creates new core schemas, plugin-facing types, operator data, gateway methods, CLI commands, and a top-level UI route; those long-lived commitments require maintainer intent rather than automated code repair.

options.title: Sponsor a core design
options.body: Approve the direction but require canonical event ingestion, SQLite retention, typed read-scoped protocol descriptors, and a reviewed privacy contract before merge.

options.title: Keep telemetry-only
options.body: Retain exporter work only and defer the query store, CLI, dashboard, and plugin API until a later product design is approved.

options.title: Pause the series
options.body: Defer or close the stacked PRs until a maintainer-backed architecture issue defines scope and ownership.

recommendation.title: Sponsor a core design
recommendation.body: Approve the direction but require canonical event ingestion, SQLite retention, typed read-scoped protocol descriptors, and a reviewed privacy contract before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This decision spans core product scope, security posture, and long-lived public contracts.
